title: Praising and criticising
about: Collocations for praising and criticising people and their work: nothing but praise, thunderous applause, a standing ovation, sing someone's praises, come in for criticism, constructive criticism, strongly disapprove of, universal condemnation.

items.pattern: have nothing but praise for sb / sth
items.meaning: praise someone or something a lot and have no criticism at all
items.uk: не мати нічого, крім похвали; тільки хвалити
items.example: We **have nothing but praise for** the nurses who looked after Dad in hospital.
more: My neighbours **have nothing but praise for** the new bakery on the corner.
The parents **had nothing but praise for** the teacher who took the class camping.
items.watchOut: Nothing but тут — «нічого, крім»: nothing but praise. Praise зазвичай незлічуване: без a і без -s (не a praise, не praises; множина — лише у сталому sing sb's praises). Прийменник — for: praise for sb / sth.

items.pattern: offer (sb) your congratulations (on sth) · formal
items.meaning: congratulate someone, especially in a formal speech or letter
items.example: I'd like to **offer my congratulations** to the bride and groom.
more: The mayor **offered his congratulations** to everyone who ran the city marathon.
Please **offer my congratulations** to your daughter on her new job.
items.watchOut: Congratulations тут завжди у множині: my congratulations, не my congratulation. Вітати з чимось — congratulate sb on sth, не with: congratulations on your new job. «Привітати з днем народження» — wish sb a happy birthday, а не congratulate.

items.pattern: thunderous applause · to thunderous applause
items.meaning: very loud clapping from a large audience
items.example: When the school choir finished, the hall broke into **thunderous applause**.
more: The bride's father sat down to **thunderous applause** after his funny speech.
The players walked onto the pitch to **thunderous applause**.
items.watchOut: «Бурхливі оплески» — thunderous applause, не stormy applause. Applause незлічуване: без a і без -s. Одна «хвиля» оплесків — a round of applause.

items.pattern: richly / justly deserve sth · be richly / justly deserved
items.meaning: completely deserve something good, such as praise, a prize or a rest
items.example: After a year of night shifts, she **richly deserves** a long holiday.
more: Congratulations on your award. It was **justly deserved**.
Everyone agreed that the bus driver's bravery award was **richly deserved**.
items.watchOut: Richly тут не «багато», а «сповна, повною мірою»; justly — «по заслузі». Так зазвичай кажуть про щось добре: нагороду, похвалу, відпочинок. Схожі варіанти — well deserved, fully deserved.

items.pattern: put on a production / play / show / concert
items.meaning: organise and perform a show for an audience
items.example: The hospital staff **put on a show** for the children on the ward at Christmas.
more: Our street **put on a concert** to raise money for the new playground.
The students are **putting on a production** of 'Romeo and Juliet' in May.
items.watchOut: «Поставити виставу» — put on a production / play / show (або stage a play). Без on не можна: put a play — помилка. Не make a show: make a show of sth — це «демонстративно щось робити».

items.pattern: a (simply) dazzling production / performance / display
items.meaning: a show or performance so impressive that it amazes people
items.example: The ice show was **a dazzling production**, full of lights, music and colour.
more: Critics called the new 'Cinderella' **a simply dazzling production**.
The young gymnasts gave **a dazzling display** at the end of the competition.
items.watchOut: Dazzling — «приголомшливий» (про виставу, виступ) і «сліпучий» (dazzling sunshine). Dazzled — про людину: «вражений, засліплений» (I was dazzled by the show). A dazzled production — помилка.

items.pattern: give an outstanding / a brilliant performance
items.meaning: perform extremely well in a play, concert, match etc.
items.example: The boy who played the king **gave an outstanding performance**, and he's only nine.
more: The orchestra **gave an outstanding performance** of Beethoven's Fifth.
The runner **gave an outstanding performance** and broke the club record.
items.watchOut: Виступити — give a performance, не make a performance. «Видатний виступ» — outstanding, не prominent: prominent — «помітний, відомий» (a prominent writer).

items.pattern: take (full / all the) credit for sth
items.meaning: say or accept that a success was your own work
items.uk: приписувати собі (всю) заслугу, вважати успіх своїм
items.example: My brother cooked the turkey, but Dad **took full credit for** the dinner.
more: I can't **take all the credit for** the garden. My neighbour did half the work.
Some people always **take credit for** other people's ideas.
items.watchOut: Credit тут — «заслуга, визнання», а не кредит у банку. «Приписати собі заслугу» — take (the) credit for sth, не take the merit і не credit of.

items.pattern: warmly / heartily congratulate sb (on sth)
items.meaning: congratulate someone in a sincere, friendly way
items.example: The coach **warmly congratulated** every player after the final.
more: I'd like to **warmly congratulate** Anna on passing her driving test.
Our neighbours **warmly congratulated** us on the birth of our son.
items.watchOut: «Щиро вітаю» — warmly / heartily congratulate, не hotly congratulate (калька з «гаряче вітаю»). Прийменник — on: congratulate sb on sth, не with.

items.pattern: receive / win critical acclaim · be critically acclaimed
items.meaning: get very enthusiastic praise from critics
items.example: Her first novel **received critical acclaim**, but hardly anyone bought it.
more: The small family restaurant has **won critical acclaim** for its simple home cooking.
The film was **critically acclaimed**, and it won three awards.
items.watchOut: Critical тут — «від критиків», а не «критичний, негативний»: critical acclaim — це захоплена похвала. Acclaim незлічуване, без a. Вимова: /əˈkleɪm/.

items.pattern: get / receive rave reviews · a rave review · informal
items.meaning: very enthusiastic opinions in reviews (informal)
items.example: The new pizza place on our street has been getting **rave reviews**.
more: My aunt's apple pie always gets **rave reviews** at family parties.
The hotel had **rave reviews** online, so we booked it straight away.
items.watchOut: Rave reviews — тільки захоплені, позитивні відгуки. Це розмовне сполучення; в офіційному тексті краще excellent reviews. Rave як іменник — це ще й «рейв, танцювальна вечірка».

items.pattern: give sb credit for sth · give credit to sb (for sth)
items.meaning: say that someone deserves praise for something they did
items.uk: віддати комусь належне, визнати чиюсь заслугу
items.example: You have to **give** Tom **credit for** organising the whole party on his own.
more: In her speech, the singer **gave credit to** her first music teacher.
Let's **give credit** where it's due: the decorations were all Sam's idea.
items.watchOut: «Віддати належне» — give sb credit (for sth) або give sb their due. Прийменник — for: give her credit for trying, не in trying.

items.pattern: win / receive / earn (a lot of / high) praise (for sth)
items.meaning: be praised by people for something good you have done
items.example: The young firefighter **won praise** for saving a dog from the river.
more: The new hospital menu has **won** a lot of **praise** from patients.
The café **won praise** for staying open during the snowstorm.
items.watchOut: Win тут — не «перемогти», а «здобути, заслужити»: win praise, win support. Praise незлічуване: a lot of praise, high praise, не many praises.

items.pattern: receive / get a standing ovation · give sb a standing ovation
items.meaning: be applauded by an audience who stand up because they liked a performance so much
items.example: At the end of the school concert, the music teacher **received a standing ovation**.
more: The whole stadium **gave** the old captain **a standing ovation**.
My grandmother's speech at her 90th birthday party **got a standing ovation**.
items.watchOut: «Аплодувати стоячи» — give sb a standing ovation, не applaud standing і не a standing applause. Вимова ovation: /əʊˈveɪʃn/, наголос на другому складі.

items.pattern: think the world of sb · informal
items.meaning: love, admire or respect someone very much
items.uk: дуже любити й цінувати когось, душі в комусь не чути
items.example: The kids **think the world of** their swimming coach.
more: My grandad **thought the world of** his old dog.
She **thinks the world of** her little brother and would do anything for him.
items.watchOut: Сталий вираз: think the world of sb — з артиклем the і прийменником of. Не think the world about sb.

items.pattern: sing sb's / sth's praises · sing the praises of sb / sth · informal
items.meaning: praise someone or something a lot, often to other people
items.example: My mum is always **singing the praises** of her new hairdresser.
more: Everyone at the gym is **singing your praises**. They say you're the best trainer there.
Since her holiday in Croatia, Lena has been **singing its praises** to anyone who'll listen.
items.watchOut: Тут praises — у множині: sing sb's praises, sing the praises of sb. Не sing sb a praise.

items.pattern: speak highly / well of sb · think highly of sb
items.meaning: say good things about someone
items.example: All my friends **speak highly of** this mechanic, so I'll take the car to him.
more: The old lady **spoke well of** everyone in the village.
Everyone at the club **speaks** very **highly of** the new coach.
items.watchOut: Прийменник — зазвичай of: speak highly of sb. Highly тут — «схвально, з повагою», не high і не «голосно» (голосно — loudly).

items.pattern: warmly / heartily approve of sb / sth
items.meaning: like something and fully support it
items.example: My parents **heartily approve of** my plan to study medicine.
more: Grandma **warmly approves of** my new girlfriend. She says she's very polite.
The whole street **heartily approved of** the idea of a summer party.
items.watchOut: Схвалювати — approve of sb / sth, з of. Approve sth без of — затвердити офіційно: The bank approved the loan. Не approve to.

items.pattern: give your blessing (to sth) · give sb / sth your blessing
items.meaning: say that you agree with a plan and wish it well
items.example: Dad finally **gave his blessing** to my plan to travel round Asia.
more: The council has **given its blessing** to a new skate park.
The head teacher has **given her blessing** to a school trip to Paris.
items.watchOut: «Дати добро» — give your blessing (або give the go-ahead), не give the good. Тут blessing — не обов'язково релігійне: це просто згода, схвалення плану.

items.phrase: give sb a big clap / a round of applause
items.pattern: give sb a big clap / a (big) round of applause
items.meaning: clap your hands to show that you liked what someone did
items.example: Let's **give** our volunteers **a big clap**. They've worked all day!
more: The passengers **gave** the pilot **a round of applause** after the bumpy landing.
At the end of the lesson, the kids **gave** their teacher **a round of applause**.
items.watchOut: Applause незлічуване: не an applause і не a big applause. Кажуть a round of applause або a big clap (розмовне, британське). Ще природно: give sb a big hand.

items.pattern: deserve / give sb / get a pat on the back · give yourself a pat on the back
items.meaning: praise for something you have done well
items.example: You cleaned the whole flat before the guests arrived. You deserve **a pat on the back**!
more: My boss gave me **a pat on the back** for staying late to help.
Everyone who gave blood today deserves **a pat on the back**.
items.watchOut: Буквально — поплескування по спині, але здебільшого це похвала. У сталому виразі — тільки back: не a pat on the shoulder.

items.pattern: come in for (a lot of / heavy / harsh) criticism
items.meaning: be criticised by people
items.example: The referee **came in for criticism** after he missed an obvious foul.
more: The hotel **came in for** a lot of **criticism** after guests found mice in the kitchen.
Celebrities who fly in private jets often **come in for criticism**.
items.watchOut: «Зазнати критики» — come in for criticism (або come under criticism), не fall under criticism і не get under criticism. Обидва слова, in і for, обов'язкові.

items.pattern: respond to (the) criticism (by doing sth)
items.meaning: answer or react to what critics have said
items.example: The café owner **responded to the criticism** by lowering her prices.
more: How you **respond to criticism** says a lot about you.
The mayor **responded to criticism** of the dirty streets by hiring more cleaners.
items.watchOut: Respond (reply, react) — з to: respond to criticism, не respond on і не answer on criticism. Answer — без прийменника: answer the criticism.

items.pattern: counter (the) criticism (by doing sth / with sth)
items.meaning: answer criticism by criticising your critic back or by giving strong arguments against it
items.uk: дати відсіч критиці, відповісти на критику контраргументами
items.example: When people said our dog was noisy, we **countered the criticism** by pointing out the neighbours' loud parties.
more: The coach **countered the criticism** by reminding reporters that the team had won five games in a row.
Mum **countered** Dad's **criticism** of her driving by mentioning his parking tickets.

items.pattern: dismiss (the) criticism (as sth)
items.meaning: say that criticism is untrue or not important
items.example: The landlord **dismissed the criticism** and said the heating worked perfectly.
more: My brother **dismisses** any **criticism** of his driving.
The restaurant **dismissed the criticism** as the work of a jealous rival.
items.watchOut: Відкинути критику як щось — dismiss sth as …, не dismiss like … . Dismiss sb — ще й «звільнити з роботи».

items.pattern: express / show / voice your disapproval (of sth)
items.meaning: let people see or hear that you think something is wrong or bad
items.example: Grandma **showed her disapproval** of my tattoo by refusing to look at it.
more: Several neighbours **expressed their disapproval** of the new phone mast.
The fans **expressed their disapproval** by booing the referee.
items.watchOut: Disapproval of sth — з of: disapproval of smoking. «Висловити несхвалення» — express (або voice) disapproval, не say disapproval.

items.pattern: give sb a look / frown of disapproval · a disapproving look
items.meaning: an expression on your face that shows you think something is wrong
items.example: When my phone rang during the film, the woman next to me gave me **a look of disapproval**.
more: Dad answered my question about the party with **a frown of disapproval**.
The waiter gave us **a look of disapproval** when we asked for ketchup with the steak.
items.watchOut: Frown — насуплені (зсунуті) брови. «Несхвальний погляд» — a look of disapproval або a disapproving look, не a disapproval look.

items.pattern: harsh / strong / severe criticism
items.meaning: very strong criticism, often unkind
items.example: The singer's new album has received **harsh criticism**, but her fans love it.
more: My first cake got some **harsh criticism** from my brothers, but I kept practising.
The hospital faced **harsh criticism** after a patient waited ten hours.
items.watchOut: «Жорстка, різка критика» — harsh / strong / severe / sharp criticism, не rigid criticism і зазвичай не hard criticism.

items.pattern: constant criticism (from sb / of sth)
items.meaning: criticism that never stops
items.example: She left the job because of her manager's **constant criticism**.
more: Children who hear **constant criticism** at home often lose confidence.
I'm tired of your **constant criticism** of my cooking!
items.watchOut: «Постійна критика» — constant criticism, не permanent criticism: permanent — «постійний» у значенні «назавжди, не тимчасовий» (a permanent job, a permanent address).

items.pattern: constructive criticism · give / accept constructive criticism
items.meaning: useful criticism that helps you improve
items.example: My piano teacher gives me lots of **constructive criticism**, so I'm improving fast.
more: I'm happy to hear **constructive criticism**, but please don't just say it's bad.
Good managers know how to give **constructive criticism** without upsetting people.
items.watchOut: Конструктивна — constructive, не constructional (constructional — «будівельний, конструкційний»). Criticism зазвичай незлічуване: some constructive criticism.

items.pattern: be highly / sharply critical of sb / sth
items.meaning: criticise someone or something strongly
items.uk: дуже (різко) критично ставитися до когось / чогось
items.example: Local parents are **highly critical of** the plan to close the village school.
more: My aunt is **sharply critical of** anyone who drops litter.
The report was **highly critical of** the hospital's cleaning.
items.watchOut: Після critical — of: critical of sb / sth. Critical to sth означає інше: «вкрай важливий для». Highly critical — «дуже критичний» (highly, не high).

items.pattern: roundly / fiercely / bitterly criticise sb / sth (for sth) · be roundly criticised
items.meaning: criticise someone or something very strongly
items.example: The airport was **roundly criticised** for its long queues at passport control.
more: Fans **fiercely criticised** the decision to sell their best player.
The new parking rules have been **bitterly criticised** by shop owners.
items.watchOut: Roundly тут — не «кругло», а «рішуче, з усіх боків». «Гостро критикувати» — criticise sharply / fiercely, не acutely. Британське написання — criticise, американське — criticize.

items.pattern: a harsh / an outspoken critic (of sb / sth) · your harshest critic
items.meaning: a person who criticises something strongly and says openly exactly what they think
items.example: My sister is my **harshest critic**: she always tells me when my singing is awful.
more: Our neighbour is **an outspoken critic** of the new wind farm.
Even the **harshest critics** liked the new bridge.
items.watchOut: Critic — людина, яка критикує; criticism — сама критика; critique — розгорнутий розбір, рецензія. Outspoken — «відвертий, прямий», а не «балакучий».

items.pattern: strongly / thoroughly disapprove of sb / sth / doing sth
items.meaning: think that something is very wrong or bad
items.example: My dad **strongly disapproves of** people using phones at the dinner table.
more: I **thoroughly disapprove of** feeding ducks white bread.
Her parents **strongly disapproved of** her plan to leave university.
items.watchOut: Disapprove — з of: disapprove of smoking, не disapprove smoking і не disapprove against. «Категорично не схвалюю» — strongly disapprove, не categorically disapprove (categorically зазвичай з deny, refuse).

items.pattern: severely condemn sb / sth (for sth) · be severely condemned
items.meaning: say very strongly and publicly that someone or something is wrong
items.example: The mayor **severely condemned** the drivers who blocked the ambulance.
more: The school **severely condemned** the bullying and spoke to every parent.
The shop was **severely condemned** for selling alcohol to teenagers.
items.watchOut: «Засуджувати» поведінку чи вчинок — condemn; «засудити» в суді до покарання — sentence: He was sentenced to two years. Вимова: /kənˈdem/, n у кінці не звучить.

items.pattern: universal / wholesale condemnation · meet with / receive / earn universal condemnation
items.meaning: strong criticism from (almost) everyone
items.example: The decision to cut down the old oak tree met with **universal condemnation** in the village.
more: The singer's joke about nurses met with **universal condemnation** online.
The plan to build flats on the park led to **wholesale condemnation** from residents.
items.watchOut: Universal тут — «загальний, від усіх», не обов'язково «всесвітній». Wholesale — «масовий, суцільний», а не «оптовий». «Загальне засудження» — universal або widespread condemnation, не common condemnation.

items.pattern: strongly / strenuously object to sth / doing sth
items.meaning: say firmly, with a lot of effort, that you are against something
items.example: The neighbours **strenuously objected to** the plan to open a nightclub on our street.
more: I **strongly object to** paying for a plastic bag.
Many parents **strongly objected to** the shorter lunch break.
items.watchOut: Object to + іменник або -ing: object to paying, не object to pay і не object against. Вимова дієслова — /əbˈdʒekt/, наголос на другому складі (іменник object — /ˈɒbdʒɪkt/).

warmup.q: We ___ congratulate you on your new home!
warmup.explain: Щиро вітати — warmly (або heartily) congratulate. Hotly — калька з «гаряче вітаю», honestly — «чесно».
Бурхливі оплески — thunderous applause. Stormy і thundery — про погоду.

warmup.q: The audience gave her a ___ ovation.
warmup.explain: Аплодувати стоячи — give sb a standing ovation.

warmup.uk: Мені набридла постійна критика від сусідки.
warmup.q: I'm fed up with my neighbour's ___ criticism.
warmup.explain: Постійна (безперервна) критика — constant criticism. Permanent — «постійний» у сенсі «назавжди»: a permanent job.

warmup.uk: Нове меню шкільної їдальні зазнало критики.
warmup.q: The new school menu has ___ a lot of criticism.
warmup.explain: Зазнати критики — come in for (або come under) criticism. Fall under / get under — кальки.

warmup.uk: Учителі дуже добре відгукуються про вашого сина.
warmup.q: The teachers speak very ___ of your son.
warmup.explain: Добре відгукуватися про когось — speak highly (або well) of sb. Loudly — «голосно».

warmup.uk: Я категорично проти того, щоб працювати в суботи.
warmup.q: I strongly object ___ working on Saturdays.
warmup.explain: Object to + -ing: object to working. Object against — помилка.

warmup.q: Let's give the winners a ___ of applause!
warmup.explain: Поаплодувати комусь — give sb a round of applause (або a big clap).

A.q: My cousin's new restaurant got ___ reviews in all the local papers.
It's not fair to ___ all the credit for the project when the whole class helped.
A.explain: Приписати собі заслугу — take (the) credit for sth.

A.q: My kids think the ___ of their grandad.
A.explain: Think the world of sb — дуже любити й цінувати когось. Сталий вираз, тільки world.

B.q: The best kind of feedback is ___ criticism: it shows you how to do better.
B.explain: Корисна критика, що допомагає стати кращим, — constructive criticism. Constructional — «будівельний».

B.q: The writer is a well-known ___ of reality TV shows.
B.explain: Людина, яка критикує, — a critic. Criticism — сама критика, critique — розбір, рецензія.

B.q: The cat ___ its disapproval of the new food by walking away from the bowl.
B.explain: Виявити несхвалення — show (або express) your disapproval.

example.title: The school play
example.uk:
Минулої п'ятниці наша школа поставила виставу «Пітер Пен». Вона була просто приголомшливою. Моя донька, яка грала Венді, блискуче виступила, а наприкінці всім акторам аплодували стоячи.

Наступного ранку в місцевій газеті про виставу не було нічого, крім похвали. Директор щиро привітав дітей, але вчителька музики відмовилася приписувати весь успіх собі й віддала належне батькам, які шили костюми.

Негативним був лише один відгук. Місцевий критик сказав, що вистава задовга. Директор з усмішкою відмахнувся від критики: «Десять хвилин громових оплесків не можуть помилятися».
example.en:
Last Friday our school [[put on a production|a5]] of 'Peter Pan'. It was [[simply dazzling|a6]]. My daughter, who played Wendy, [[gave an outstanding performance|a7]], and at the end the whole cast [[received a standing ovation|a14]].

The next morning the local paper [[had nothing but praise for|a1]] the show. The head teacher [[warmly congratulated|a9]] the children, but the music teacher refused to [[take full credit for|a8]] the success and [[gave credit to|a12]] the parents who made the costumes.

Only one review was negative. A local critic said the play was too long. The head teacher [[dismissed the criticism|b4]] with a smile: 'Ten minutes of [[thunderous applause|a3]] can't be wrong.'
